title: Ramparts MCP Security Scan Report
executive_summary:
Risk Level: HIGH
Security Score: 65/100
Vulnerabilities Found: 4

The MCP server has significant security concerns that should be addressed.

The scan identified 4 potential security issue(s) across the MCP server's tools and resources.
Immediate action is recommended to address the findings.

security_issues.description: Tool accepts filesystem paths that could potentially access sensitive files
security_issues.recommendation: Implement strict path validation and sandboxing

tools.name: execute-yara
tools.description: Execute YARA rules on target files

security_issues.description: Tool executes user-provided YARA rules without sufficient validation
security_issues.recommendation: Implement YARA rule sandboxing and validation

security_issues.description: Complex YARA rules could cause CPU/memory exhaustion
security_issues.recommendation: Add resource limits and timeout controls

security_issues.description: May expose sensitive information from previous scans
security_issues.recommendation: Implement access controls and data sanitization

prompts.name: analyze-security
prompts.description: Analyze security implications of MCP configurations

vulnerabilities_found.description: YARA rule execution accepts user-provided rules without validation
vulnerabilities_found.recommendation: Implement strict YARA rule validation and sandboxing
vulnerabilities_found.impact: Remote code execution potential through malicious YARA rules

vulnerabilities_found.description: Configuration scanning tool accepts arbitrary filesystem paths
vulnerabilities_found.recommendation: Restrict path access to specific directories
vulnerabilities_found.impact: Potential access to sensitive configuration files

vulnerabilities_found.description: Historical scan results may contain sensitive information
vulnerabilities_found.recommendation: Implement access controls and data retention policies
vulnerabilities_found.impact: Exposure of previously scanned server configurations

vulnerabilities_found.description: Complex YARA rules could cause DoS through resource consumption
vulnerabilities_found.recommendation: Add CPU/memory limits and execution timeouts

scan_results.summary: MCP server has significant security concerns requiring immediate attention. High-risk code injection vulnerability found in YARA execution tool.

recommendations: • Implement strict YARA rule validation and sandboxing
• Restrict path access to specific directories
• Implement access controls and data retention policies
• Add CPU/memory limits and execution timeouts
• Implement comprehensive input validation for all tools
